GACOS MANUAL SUBMISSIONS  (http://www.gacos.net)
Common settings for EVERY submission below:
  Time of Interest (UTC):  H = 0   M = 0
  Output format:           Geotiff
  Email:                   <your email>
Form cap: max 20 dates per submission, max 10x10 degrees.

After each job, you'll get a download URL by email. Drop all archives into one
directory and ingest with:
  cd ~/infra-proptech/backend
  python -m scripts.fetch_gacos ingest-dir --dir ~/Downloads/gacos
(It auto-routes each archive to the right AOI by GeoTIFF centre.)
